lines: First, he had made his subordinates fight Saitou Hanjirou, to observe his fighting style and ninja arts.
That was his way of doing things.
（Well, it's like the investigation said, huh?）
A superhuman-type ninja art, wherein Saitou sprouted two arms.
It was unusual, but as long as Kageomi knew about it, it was no big deal.
（A guy this weak is the “serial killer” who's shaking up Gosha? That's sure a surprise.）
（Does that mean he racked up his crimes by a ton of luck?）
（That stuff doesn't matter to me, though.）
An assassin had no need for any unnecessary thoughts.
Kageomi was that kind of a man.
「Go away. I've no interest in herde.」
Saitou said, using that word from before again.
Perhaps because it referred to “a group of slaves”, it seemed to be a pet word of his.
「A master of four-armed martial arts. Is that all you've got?」
「You've done your prep work, haven't you? These three don't seem to have been able to make use of that, though.」
「Prep work, huh? Figures a Gosha Academy teacher would say things different, huh?」
「There are only a handful of people qualified to take lessons from me.」
「And all the rest are those herduh? Well, whatever.」
「To me, you're a kinda let-down as an opponent, though, see?」
「I've assassinated tons of scarier ninja art users before, after all.」
「The serial killer who's shaken Gosha. I was looking forward to seein' what kinda guy it would be, but I'm disappointed.」
「You're still continuing that asinine chitchat, are you? I would like to get this over with quickly and go home, though.」
「That's a good idea. It's always best to get your work done quickly. Especially killing.」
Saitou shook his head theatrically, with a visibly disappointed-looking face.
「I do not think my views are in alignment with yours. To think that you would interpret murder in such a simple way. Mind you, there are actually two types of―――」
Kageomi exaggeratedly waved his hand back at Saitou, who was about to start preaching the virtues of homicide.
「Yeah, okay, okay. I got no interest in your views. Not even a little.」
「I'm gonna carry out the orders I've been given in my own way: simply.」
「Then please come at me already. This is a waste of time.」
Saitou readied his four arms alertly, but with a face that seemed very tired of this.
However, Kageomi wasn't about to stupidly charge in like the trio who had just been defeated.
He was a man who didn't let his guard down.
He unleashed the next pawns (after his useless subordinates) that he had been provided with by the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office.
Cautiously, in order to make certain he killed Saitou.
